title: Kamakura, then Yokohama
call: A great day for the coast. tenki.jp has Kamakura sunny until about 15:00, 0 to 10%, then cloud for Yokohama with no rain. About 24° when you reach Kamakura at 10:30, 26 to 27° for pancakes and the Yuigahama walk around 12:00 to 14:00. A steady south-westerly, about 4 m/s, so a sea breeze on the beach, and still about 3 m/s on the Vanish coaster and ferris wheel around 16:00 to 18:00, at about 24°. JMA has 20% by evening and a stray shower possible late at night, after you're home. Sunscreen and water.
